criteria.evidence: The listing shows 74 photos, well above the 40+ best-practice benchmark.

The 1152-character description names the CBD location, '5-minute walk from Melbourne Central Station' and room features, but never mentions parking and ends with a garbled line: 'Valid photo ID is required a physical (Passport / Driver's License). physical).'

Exactly 10 facilities are listed ('Fitness centre', 'Free WiFi', 'Laundry', 'BBQ facilities'…), but lockers, the shared kitchen, the lounge/common room and air conditioning appear only in the description, not in the facility list, and parking could not be verified.

All 14 room types are priced and most state the bed setup (e.g. 'Bed in 6-Bed Mixed Dormitory Room with Shared Bathroom'), but 'Bed in Semi Private 4-Bed Mixed Dormitory room' is unexplained and capitalisation is inconsistent.

Free cancellation is offered, but the policies state 'Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type', so it could not be verified that every room type has a free-cancellation rate.
Loyalty programme (Genius) participation was found on the listing.
The review response rate is null, so owner replies could not be verified on the page.
Review score 8.6/10 from 1789 reviews, above the 8.5 strong threshold.

fixes.fix: In the Booking.com extranet Facilities section, tick Lockers, Shared kitchen, Shared lounge/TV area, Air conditioning, Heating, Rooftop terrace and Tea/coffee, and add your parking status (paid, nearby or none).
fixes.expected_impact: Hostel guests filter on lockers, kitchen and common room, so features that are only mentioned in the text are invisible to those filters and to the facility score.

fixes.fix: Reply to all new reviews, and to the backlog of recent ones, from the extranet; answer every review below 7 within 48 hours with a specific fix.
fixes.expected_impact: Visible replies on 1789 reviews reassure bookers reading negatives and signal an active host to the ranking algorithm.

fixes.fix: Update 'Accepted payment methods', which currently shows only 'Cash', to list the credit and debit cards you accept, matching the AUD 200 card damage deposit and card check-in requirement.
fixes.expected_impact: A cash-only label contradicts the card requirements and can scare off international backpackers at checkout.

fixes.fix: Rewrite the description ending: fix the garbled 'Valid photo ID is required a physical ... physical).' sentence, move the ID and credit-card rules to the policies section, and add a parking or transport sentence.
fixes.expected_impact: A clean, complete description reads as professional and answers the parking question before guests bounce.

fixes.fix: Check that every one of the 14 room types, especially the dorm beds, has a free-cancellation rate plan alongside any non-refundable rate.
fixes.expected_impact: Free-cancellation options on all rooms lift conversion and keep the listing visible under the free-cancellation filter.

fixes.fix: Rename 'Bed in Semi Private 4-Bed Mixed Dormitory room' to state what makes it semi-private (e.g. curtained pod beds), and standardise capitalisation such as 'Standard Queen Room with Private Bathroom'.
fixes.expected_impact: Clear dorm names reduce booking hesitation and mismatched-expectation complaints.

fixes.fix: Review the last 3 months of sub-8 reviews for recurring complaints (e.g. noise, cleanliness, shared bathrooms), fix the top issue, and ask satisfied guests at checkout to leave a review.
fixes.expected_impact: Lifting 8.6 toward 8.8+ strengthens ranking and the 'Excellent' badge against CBD hostel competitors.
